title: Hebrews Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Hebrews 4: the rest that remains, the living and active word of God, and the great high priest who was tempted as we are.

questions.text: Why did the word they heard not profit the people spoken of in verse 2?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says good news was preached to them as well, but the word they heard did not profit them because it was not mixed with faith by those who heard it.

answers.text: It was not mixed with faith by those who heard it
No good news had ever been preached to them
It was spoken to them in a language that they did not know
It was preached only to their leaders

questions.text: About which day does the text quote the words "God rested ... from all his works"?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says that he has said this somewhere about the seventh day: God rested on the seventh day from all his works.

questions.text: In the words spoken through David, what should people not do if they hear his voice?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 quotes: "Today if you will hear his voice, don't harden your hearts."

questions.text: Whose giving of rest, the text says, would have made another day unnecessary?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 says that if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

questions.text: What does the text say still remains for the people of God?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says there remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

questions.text: What is the word of God said to be sharper than?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword.

questions.text: According to verse 12, what is the word of God able to discern?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says the word of God is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

answers.text: The movements of the stars and the planets
The number of the nations on the earth
The times and the seasons of the year
The thoughts and intentions of the heart

questions.text: What does verse 13 say about creatures and God's sight?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says there is no creature hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before his eyes.

answers.text: Only people are laid open before him
No creature is hidden from his sight
The heavens hide nothing, but the earth does
Hidden things stay hidden until the judgment

questions.text: What does the text say about the high priest we have?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says we do not have a high priest who cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been tempted in all points like we are, yet without sin.

answers.text: Never tempted, because he is the Son of God
Tempted, and he sinned like other men
Tempted in all points like we are, yet without sin
Unable to be touched by our infirmities

questions.text: What does the text say we receive when we draw near with boldness to the throne of grace?
questions.explanation: Verse 16 says we draw near with boldness so that we may receive mercy and find grace for help in time of need.

answers.text: Mercy, and grace for help in time of need
A new name written on a stone of white marble
A seat beside the throne itself
